text:
## REGULATORY COMPLIANCE  
**Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Disclosure:**
The Annual Percentage Rate is the interest rate shown (AER), which includes compounding.  
**Gross Interest:**
Interest paid without tax withholding. You're responsible for reporting to HMRC if applicable.

raw_entities.description: Customer guidance clarifying that interest is paid gross (without tax withholding) and that customers bear responsibility for reporting interest income to HMRC where applicable. This sets expectations around tax obligations.
